caveat: Derived from HS-T007 (Overview and Important Caveats) and the stage structure of HS-T002. There is no universal, finite linguistics canon: reading lists are historically contingent, subfield-specific, and institutionally variable. Entries below form a structured meta-canon of recurring foundational monographs, papers, and reference corpora.

works.title: Cours de linguistique generale (Course in General Linguistics)
works.focus: Langue vs parole, arbitrariness of the sign, synchronic vs diachronic analysis.

works.title: Language: An Introduction to the Study of Speech
works.focus: Morphological typology, drift, and the relationship between linguistic form and culture.

works.title: Language
works.focus: American structuralist methodology, phoneme/morpheme distribution, and comparative reconstruction.

works.title: Grundzuge der Phonologie (Principles of Phonology)
works.focus: Phonological systems defined by distinctive oppositions and neutralization.

works.title: Problemes de linguistique generale (Problems in General Linguistics)
works.focus: Enunciation, subjectivity in language, person deixis, and Indo-European lexical institutions.

works.title: Syntactic Structures
works.focus: Inadequacy of finite-state grammars for natural syntax; transformational rules.

works.title: Aspects of the Theory of Syntax
works.focus: Competence vs performance, lexicon/subcategorization, and deep vs surface structure.

works.title: The Sound Pattern of English (SPE)
works.focus: Rule-ordered generative phonology and binary distinctive-feature matrices.

works.title: Optimality Theory: Constraint Interaction in Generative Grammar
works.focus: Ranked violable universal constraints replacing serial rewrite rules (1993 manuscript / 2004 book).

works.title: Word Formation in Generative Grammar
works.focus: Word-based derivational morphology, productivity, and blocking.

works.title: A-Morphous Morphology
works.focus: Realizational paradigm rules without treating inflectional affixes as classical morpheme signs.

works.title: Formal Philosophy: Selected Papers
works.focus: Model-theoretic intensional logic applied compositionally to natural language syntax.

works.title: Meaning and Grammar: An Introduction to Semantics
works.focus: Truth-conditional semantics, quantification, presupposition, and type-driven composition.

works.title: How to Do Things with Words
works.focus: Performatives and the locutionary, illocutionary, and perlocutionary dimensions of speech acts.

works.title: Logic and Conversation (in Studies in the Way of Words)
works.focus: Cooperative Principle, conversational maxims, and conversational implicature.

works.title: Sociolinguistic Patterns
works.focus: Quantitative variationist sociolinguistics, social stratification, and sound change in progress.

works.title: Linguistic Variation as Social Practice
works.focus: Third-wave variation study linking phonetic style to communities of practice and indexical fields.

works.title: Some Universals of Grammar with Particular Reference to the Order of Meaningful Elements
works.focus: Implicational word-order universals and cross-linguistic sampling.

works.title: Language Universals and Linguistic Typology
works.focus: Cross-linguistic alignment (ergative/accusative), animacy hierarchies, and relative clauses.

works.authors: M. A. K. Halliday & Christian M. I. M. Matthiessen
works.title: Halliday's Introduction to Functional Grammar
works.focus: Ideational, interpersonal, and textual metafunctions in Systemic Functional Linguistics.

works.title: Metaphors We Live By
works.focus: Conceptual metaphor and embodied grounding of abstract semantic domains.

works.title: Constructing a Language: A Usage-Based Theory of Language Acquisition
works.focus: Intention-reading, pattern-finding, and emergent constructional grammar.

works.title: Linguistique historique et linguistique generale
works.focus: Comparative method, grammaticalization, and social drivers of historical language change.

works.title: Historical Linguistics: An Introduction
works.focus: Regularity of sound change, comparative reconstruction, analogy, borrowing, and distant-genetic criteria.

works.title: Writing Systems: A Linguistic Introduction
works.focus: Semasiographic vs glottographic taxonomy and introduction of the featural category for Hangul.

works.title: The World's Writing Systems
works.focus: Authoritative reference spine defining abjad, abugida, alphabet, syllabary, logosyllabary, and featural systems.

works.title: Writing Systems: An Introduction to Their Linguistic Analysis
works.focus: Orthographic depth, grapheme theory, script reform, and sociolinguistics of literacy.

works.authors: Tiago Pimentel, Brian Roark & Ryan Cotterell
works.title: The Taxonomy of Writing Systems: How to Measure How Logographic a System Is
works.focus: Computational/information-theoretic continuum metric for logography vs phonography (cited in HS-T006).
